notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. One body serves both claws. Its socket on the Span Mount is ../900-ToolInterface/span_socket.scad's, shared with the Static Finger, and its layout along y is claw_params.scad's. It prints standing on the bearing plate's face. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
